data.title: Laboratory Technician / Operator BTA/CTA – Protein Analytics (all genders)
data.description:
Role Overview

Help us ensure the quality and reliability behind every protein we bring to life.

As our Laboratory Technician - Protein Analytics, you'll be the hands-on backbone of our analytical lab, running the routine testing that tells us exactly what's happening inside our fermentation-derived proteins. From HPLC-UV runs to sample prep for proteomics and protein assays, your careful, well-documented work gives our scientists the data they need to keep pushing our precision fermentation platform forward.
Location: Frankfurt am Main

.

About Formo

The world needs more protein than ever - not just protein that's better for the planet, but protein that performs better. We stand at the start of that shift, and we intend to lead it through precision fermentation.

Formo is the biotech protein engine for food and nutrition, starting with enhanced casein. Casein is our first hero ingredient, and it's already winning on its own merits: better functionality than animal-based casein. Sustainable, and simply better protein. And it's only the start. We're building the engine behind it: the data, the science, the speed to keep producing the next generation of high-performance proteins.

We partner with the world's leading food and nutrition manufacturers to bring these ingredients to market at scale. From our home base in Frankfurt am Main, a team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators drawn from across the globe is doing the work that decides what food is made of next. Our vision? Making the cow optional. Our common thread? A passion for challenging the status quo and transforming the food and nutrition industry.

Join us in the start of the performance era of food!


Key Responsibilities

Analytical Testing

  • Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs

  • Conduct protein assays (e.g. Bradford) and support physicochemical analyses (e.g. particle size determination)

Sample Preparation

  • Prepare samples for proteomics analyses (e.g. protein extraction, digestion, purification)

Documentation & Quality

  • Thoroughly evaluate and document results in accordance with internal guidelines

Instrument Management

  • Operate, clean, calibrate and maintain analytical instruments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with scientists to support ongoing projects


About You

Education & Experience

  • Completed training as a BTA, CTA or comparable qualification

  • Initial practical laboratory experience (e.g. through training, internships or entry-level work)

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Basic knowledge of HPLC or chromatographic methods is a plus

  • Good documentation skills

  • English proficiency at least B1 level (spoken and written); German is a plus

Mindset & Collaboration 

  • Careful, structured and reliable working style, with high motivation and scientific curiosity to learn new techniques

  • Genuine interest in protein analytics and biochemical methods

  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of responsibility


Why you’ll love it here

Ready to shake things up?

At Formo, you don’t just trade your labor for compensation - you join a mission. One powered by frontier science, real-world impact, and a team of brilliant, driven people who care deeply about what they’re building.

You’ll work side by side with interdisciplinary experts across highly skilled entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators. We believe the best ideas emerge when diverse perspectives collide, and when people are trusted with responsibility, autonomy, and meaningful challenges.

We’re building something ambitious, and we take the work seriously - but not ourselves. Expect close collaboration, fast learning and innovation, and a culture that celebrates progress (often with tastings 🧀).


What we offer:

  • Help reinvent one of the world’s most iconic food categories

  • Participate in employee equity and build long-term ownership in what we’re creating

  • Benefit from regular team off-sites, monthly perks like discounted public transport passes and fitness memberships

  • Invest in your growth with a dedicated annual development budget for learning, training, and conferences

  • Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, and an additional day after 3 and 4 years tenure

  • Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Team Impact Day

  • Work in an innovative office and lab environment with access to cutting-edge food and biotech infrastructure

  • Connect over regular team lunches, healthy and not so healthy snacks and drinks and shared moments that bring the team together


Disclaimer

Formo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, genetic information, color, physical or mental disability, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

data.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.

One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.

You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform 
  • Hands-on production experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph) and Kubernetes persistent storage (Longhorn or comparable) 
  • Experience operating API gateways and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress, or comparable), including debugging cross-cutting concerns like CORS and rate limiting 
  • Experience with CDN/edge security, DDoS mitigation, and WAF configuration (e.g. Cloudflare), as well as firewall-rule design 
  • A strong grounding in system design fundamentals (load balancing, caching, sharding/replication, consistency models, message queues) – and the judgment to apply them to real-world trade-offs 
  • Experience designing or maturing observability (tracing, metrics, SLOs/SLIs) with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry is desirable 
  • Experience with secrets/identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), messaging systems (NATS), and building on-call processes and incident runbooks from scratch is a plus 
  • Composure working with grown, incompletely documented systems – paired with the right mix of pragmatism and perfectionism: fix what's broken, retire what's dead, rather than rewriting everything 
  • Genuine enjoyment of acting as the technical go-to person across teams, actively sharing and documenting your knowledge 
  • Professional fluency in English (our working language); German language skills, certifications (CKA/CKS, Ceph training), and experience with virtualization platforms (Proxmox, OpenStack) are a plus

data.title: Director Marketing (all genders) - GPORTAL (Ociris GmbH)
data.description:
Your creative field

At GPORTAL, our vision is to build individual and easy-to-use online gaming experiences for the world. Driven by our “from gamer for gamer” passion, we've grown into one of the leading game server providers - offering more than just servers, unlike other hosting companies. For over 20 years, we've been bringing virtual worlds into people's homes with just a few clicks. Our mission: enabling experts and beginners alike to play their favourite games together with their friends. From Palworld and Enshrouded to Minecraft and Battlefield, we offer around 100 multiplayer games across every genre.


GPORTAL is looking for a Director Marketing who is ready to take the wheel of our entire marketing department, performance marketing, social media, partner management, community management, and graphic design. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will be part of the core management team from day one, with the kind of ownership over people and KPIs you will not find in every gaming company.

In your first six months, the priority is simple: keep the team running strong while you get a real feel for GPORTAL's business, our vision, and where we are headed. You will take full budget responsibility, from managing current spend and staying on top of marketing invoices to building the annual forecast. You will also size up the market to derive strategic conclusions on where we push next.

From there, you settle in as a driving force in our management team and sharpen how the marketing department works so it is well set up for the future. That includes working hand in hand with our tech teams on product-related topics such as checkout flows or game updates and launches. You also take full responsibility for onboarding, managing, and offboarding our external agencies and freelancers. On top of that, you build real connections with the marketing team over at Contabo Group to create synergies wherever possible. Just as important: brand visibility and closeness to the community. GPORTAL is a love brand to its players, and that needs to show up in the social channels and communication tools where our community actually lives.

Alongside that, you own our marketing campaigns with partner studios and the big moments like Black Friday. Last but not least, you advise our CEO directly on D2C pricing based on comprehensive market assessments, both the operative calls today and the strategic thinking further out.

Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on.

Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. In practice, that also means staying flexible and genuinely meeting people face to face rather than just online.


What convinces us

Ideally, you would have:

  • a strong, hands-on track record leading holistic marketing departments, from performance marketing to social, community, and creative, backed by solid marketing controlling, budget management, and core KPI skills
  • real performance marketing experience, paired with the ability to genuinely inspire a team toward a shared goal
  • some background in IT or hosting, plus experience working with external agencies and freelancers
  • gaming industry exposure is a nice-to-have, though a genuine feel for gaming culture matters just as much as the industry on your CV
  • some exposure to influencer management or social media marketing, and enough confidence to step into a thought-leader role in the market when needed
  • strong communication skills and a knack for handling conflict head-on, with a strategic, analytical mindset that connects campaigns to business outcomes
  • a proactive, hands-on, reliable way of working, comfortable holding yourself to a high bar under pressure
  • an open, global, adaptable mindset with genuine passion for the product and enough flexibility to compromise when the business needs it
  • fluent German and English
 
If this job offer has sparked your interest, please do reach out to us, even if you only meet some of the requirements. We'd love to get to know each other!


Awesome Prospects

  • Make an impact – Take ownership and be part of one of the most exciting growth stories in the industry
  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours and the setup you need to perform at your best
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and a wide range of fitness and wellness options
  • Dive into real challenges – Work on a wide range of technical topics that keep things exciting and far from routine
  • Keep growing – Develop your skills through hands-on experience, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning as a team
  • Learn from the best – Work alongside experienced, open-minded colleagues who support each other and share their knowledge·

  • Give back – Take a day off to support social causes through our Volunteer Day
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Have fun along the way – Most people here would say we enjoy what we do… but we’ll let you be the judge

At Ambrosys, we build data-driven systems for complex mobility and urban infrastructure challenges (B2B/B2G), including traffic insights, geolocation, tolling, and smart city solutions.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will partner with key stakeholders—including the CTO, GTM, and Product teams—to translate client goals into high-value technical solutions and drive top-line growth.

Sales Strategy Development: Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy that aligns with Ambrosys’s objectives and product portfolio to drive revenue growth. You will own end-to-end B2B and B2G sales cycles, from initial outreach and consultative deal closing through account expansion.
Market Expansion: Identify new business opportunities to expand Ambrosys’s footprint within industry verticals. You will manage new market entries and qualify high-value opportunities by testing ICP hypotheses, uncovering core pain points, and mapping buying centers and budgets.
Customer Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring a deep understanding of customer needs.
Collaboration: Work closely with the CEO, the CTO, GTM-team and Product leads to ensure alignment on sales goals, custom offers, pricing strategies, and contract negotiations.
Revenue Management: Align with ambitious sales targets, monitor performance metrics with high ownership, and meet revenue goals while maintaining profitability.
Forecasting & Reporting: Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts, reports, and insights to the CEO and CTO to enable data-driven decision-making.

data.title: Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) - Remote (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir suchen

… Dich, als Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) (m/w/d), um gemeinsam mit uns bei thermondo einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Klimaneutralität zu leisten. Mit Deinem Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien und Deiner Identifikation mit unseren Werten, unser Wort zählt, jeden Tag besser und zusammen stärker, schaffst Du einen echten Mehrwert für uns alle.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • Planungs- und Installationsstandard B2B/MFH aufbauen: Entwicklung, Dokumentation und laufende Weiterentwicklung eines verbindlichen technischen Standards für Wärmepumpen-Projekte im Mehrfamilienhaus im Bestand. Dazu gehören Heizlast, Hydraulik inklusive Kaskaden und Pufferspeicher, Trinkwarmwasser und Legionellenschutz, Elektro und Netzanschluss, Schallschutz sowie Aufstellung. Der Standard ist die Grundlage für Planung, Angebotskalkulation und Ausführung durch unsere Installationspartner.
  • Technische Baustellenbegleitung: Prüfung und Freigabe der Planungen und Angebote der Installationspartner, Kick-off vor Ort, regelmäßige Baustellenbesuche und Qualitätskontrollen, Klärung technischer Fragen und Änderungen im Bauablauf. Du bist technische Schnittstelle zu Kunden aus der Wohnungswirtschaft und zu Eigentümern, Partnern, Fachplanern und Netzbetreibern.
  • Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahme verantworten: Durchführung und Dokumentation von Zwischen- und Endabnahmen, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme, hydraulischem Abgleich, Einregulierung und Funktionsprüfung. Du verantwortest das Mängelmanagement bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe an Kunden und Service. Außerdem standardisiert du Abnahme- und Übergabeprotokolle sowie die Nachweisdokumentation für die Förderung nach BEG und KfW.
  • Skalierbare Operations-Prozesse aufbauen: Definition und Implementierung des End-to-End-Prozesses von der technischen Vorprüfung über Planung, Material und Bestellung, Ausführung, Abnahme und Übergabe in den Service. Dazu gehören Checklisten, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Meilensteine, KPIs wie Durchlaufzeit, Erstabnahme Quote und Nacharbeitsquote sowie Anforderungen an Tools wie CRM, Angebotsgenerator und Baustellendokumentation.
  • Partner qualifizieren und Qualität sichern: Technisches Onboarding, Schulung und Auditierung der Installationspartner auf den thermondo Standard. Du bewertest die Ausführungsqualität je Projekt, etabliert strukturierte Feedbackschleifen und leitest Maßnahmen wie Nachschulungen, Standard Anpassungen oder Partnerauswahl ab.
  • Technischen Vertrieb und Angebote unterstützen: Vor-Ort-Begehungen, technische Machbarkeitsprüfung und Konzeptauswahl, zum Beispiel Zentralanlage versus dezentrale Lösung, Kaskade oder Hybrid und Bivalenz. Du plausibilisiert Kalkulationen, Mengen und Aufwandsschätzungen und bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden in der Angebotsphase.
  • Lessons Learned und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Systematische Auswertung abgeschlossener Projekte hinsichtlich Kosten, Zeit, Qualität und Störungen im Betrieb. Du führst die Erkenntnisse in Standard, Produktportfolio und Kalkulationsgrundlagen zurück. Außerdem beobachtest du relevante Normen, Technik- und Fördervorhaben wie GEG, BEG, VDI 4645, DIN EN 12831 und DVGW W 551 und setzt sie im Standard um.


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel B.Eng., M.Eng. oder Dipl.-Ing., in Versorgungstechnik, Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Technischer Gebäudeausrüstung, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Alternativ verfügst du über eine SHK-Meisterausbildung oder eine staatlich geprüfte Technikerausbildung im Bereich HLK mit nachweisbarer Planungs- und Bauleitungs Erfahrung.
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung und/oder Ausführung von Heizungs- oder Wärmepumpenanlagen, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit Projekt-, Bauleitungs- oder Abnahme Verantwortung. Erfahrung mit Mehrfamilienhäusern beziehungsweise größeren Leistungsklassen über 30 kW und Kaskaden ist erforderlich. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Standards und Prozessen ist von Vorteil.
  • Fachliche Tiefe Wärmepumpe im Bestands-MFH: Heizlastberechnung, Hydraulik mit Kaskaden, Pufferspeichern und hydraulischem Abgleich, Trinkwarmwasser-Konzepte mit DVGW W 551 und Legionellenschutz, Elektro- und Netzanschluss sowie Schallschutz. Du gehst sicher mit GEG, VDI 4645, DIN EN 12831 und den technischen BEG-Anforderungen um.
  • Bauleitungs- und Abnahmekompetenz: Souveräne Baustellenbegehungen, Qualitätskontrollen, förmliche Abnahmen und Mängelmanagement nach VOB/B. Du triffst klare und dokumentierte technische Entscheidungen auch unter Zeitdruck.
  • Prozess- und Strukturdenken: Du leitest aus Einzelprojekten wiederholbare Standards, Checklisten und Prozesse ab und verankerst sie skalierbar über externe Partner und mehrere Regionen. Dabei arbeitest du KPI-orientiert und datengetrieben.
  • Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsstärke: Du kommunizierst sicher mit Handwerkspartnern, Wohnungswirtschaft und Bauherren, Fachplanern und Netzbetreibern. Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Nachunternehmer und arbeitest dabei auf Augenhöhe, verbindlich und lösungsorientiert.
  • Hands-on- und Aufbau-Mentalität: Hohe Eigenverantwortung, pragmatische Lösungsorientierung und Gestaltungswille in einem jungen Venture. Du arbeitest gleichermaßen auf der Baustelle wie am Schreibtisch und schreibst Standards selbst, statt sie nur einzufordern.
  • Anwendungskenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und Google Workspace. Erfahrung mit Heizlast- und Auslegungssoftware, zum Beispiel Hottgenroth/ETU oder Hersteller Tools von Vaillant, Viessmann und Daikin. data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
data.description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

data.title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
data.description:
Who we are and what you’ll do

HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.


Main objectives of the role

As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.


Your role and responsibilities

  • Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.

  • Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel

  • High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.

  • Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.

  • Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.

  • AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

  • Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments

  • Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.

  • Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.

  • AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.

  • Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

CEO Support

Das erwarten wir von Dir

Das zeichnet Dich für diese Position besonders aus:

  • Große Lust, dich schnell und selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und stetig dazuzulernen
  • Ein gutes Auge für Zahlen und Daten sowie Freude an Organisation
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im (Projekt-)Management oder die Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu strukturieren, zu priorisieren und voranzutreiben
  • Hohe Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit, um Dich in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Umfeld schnell zurechtzufinden
  • Interesse an Buchhaltungs- und Finanzthemen; erste Berührungspunkte (z.B. aus Studium, Ausbildung oder Praktika) sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel; Vorkenntnisse in Datev, Teams und Notion sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss

data.title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process
  • Your application as an AI Product Engineer (Senior) - short and to the point
  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team
  • Approx. 60-minute in-person interview with your hiring manager
  • Approx. 30-minute discussion with the management team

data.description:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

  • Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen daran, Business-Anforderungen zu verstehen, zu strukturieren und daraus pragmatische technische Lösungsansätze, Prototypen und MVPs zu entwickeln.
  • Du erkennst gemeinsam mit dem Team Automatisierungs- und Optimierungspotenziale und verbindest bestehende Systeme über APIs, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen.
  • Du entwickelst funktionierende Prototypen zu stabilen und wartbaren Lösungen weiter und bekommst bei Architekturfragen sowie der Integration in zentrale Systeme Unterstützung und Sparring aus unserem technischen Team und dem Core Platform Team.
  • Du sorgst mit sauberem und testbarem Code, automatisierten Tests und verständlicher technischer Dokumentation für die Qualität deiner Lösungen und nutzt moderne AI-Tools dort, wo sie deine Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen.


Deine Talente

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt und eigenständig an Anwendungen, Tools oder Automatisierungen gearbeitet. Gute Kenntnisse in Python und/oder JavaScript beziehungsweise TypeScript bringst du bereits mit.
  • Du hast ein gutes Grundverständnis von APIs, Datenbanken und grundlegenden Software-Architekturen und hast bereits mit Git sowie kollaborativen Entwicklungsprozessen gearbeitet.
  • Du kennst die Grundlagen von sauberem, wartbarem und testbarem Code und hast idealerweise bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit CI/CD, automatisierten Tests oder Docker. Du musst darin noch kein Profi sein.
  • Du denkst gerne über die reine technische Umsetzung hinaus, interessierst dich für den Business-Kontext und hast Lust, Anforderungen gemeinsam mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern weiterzuentwickeln. Gleichzeitig bist du neugierig, lernbereit und offen für Feedback.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor oder vergleichbare Anwendungen bereits im Entwicklungsalltag oder möchtest dich stärker damit beschäftigen und lernen, sie sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Fachbereichen sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau für technische Dokumentation, Tools und Code.

Tech Stack
Python | FastAPI | Docker | CI/CD | Git | SQL

Mit zahlreichen Sportgeräten im Office, Fitness- und Coffee-Breaks oder auch Corporate Benefits für mehr Spaß beim Shoppen setzen wir Ansätze für regenerative Pausen. Zeit ist ein Investment. In dich und uns.

data.title: Chief of Staff (Strategy & Operations)(All Genders)
data.description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


tl;dr

We're looking for a Chief of Staff who works closely with Nik to structurally build out our company- & org processes. 


Main information

  • Start: immediately (flexible start)
  • Location: Cologne
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Founder's Office


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week.
  • Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role.
  • Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently.
  • Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community.
  • Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap.


What you'll do - your playing field

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • End-to-end ownership of selected strategic and operational projects from concept to execution
  • Building and continuously improving central company processes
  • Close collaboration with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and prioritization
  • Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed
  • Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team


What you bring to the team

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Strong process- and structure-oriented thinking, even in ambiguity
  • Experience independently executing projects in a fast-growing environment
  • Tools: Notion, project management tool, Google Workspace, Slack
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you.


Bonus

Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup
  • Early experience building People/org processes


The Prematch Setup

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now.

  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Now it's your turn.

  • Click on ‘Apply now’ – it’ll only take 2 minutes.
  • All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
  • Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit – just apply

data.description:
Your Responsibilities

We are looking for a new colleague to join the Office of the Vice President International and University Development in Berlin. The position is academically affiliated with the Vice President International and University Development and works closely with the International Office, faculties, programme directors and international partner institutions. In this position you will support the Vice President in the day-to-day coordination of priorities and activities while also taking an active role in the development and implementation of UE’s international academic partnerships, teaching collaborations, programmes and strategic initiatives. The position combines academic and organisational support, coordination of international teaching and cooperation projects, research and strategic development. It serves as an important interface between the Vice President International, academic and administrative units across UE and international partner universities, helping to ensure that ongoing activities and new initiatives are effectively prepared, coordinated and followed through.

Key Activities & Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate ongoing international teaching collaborations, including coordination of lecturers and communication with academic partners
  • Support the development and coordination of international academic projects and cooperation formats, as well as contributing to the development and implementation of UE’s Internationalisation and Sustainability Strategies and related strategic initiatives.
  • Conduct research, benchmarking and analysis on international higher education, academic structures, potential partners and relevant international developments
  • Provide academic and organisational support to the Vice President International in day-to-day activities
  • Maintain project documentation and monitor responsibilities, deadlines and next steps across ongoing international projects
  • Prepare briefings, presentations, background information and decision-making materials for the Vice President International
  • Support further academic and strategic projects within the portfolio of the Vice President International and University Development


Your profile

  • University degree at Master’s level or equivalent in social sciences, humanities, international relations, education, management or another relevant field; a PhD is an advantage but not required
  • Previous professional experience in higher education, international academic cooperation, university management or project coordination is an advantage
  • Ability to work independently on new topics and to coordinate projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, research and organisational skills
  • Ability to structure complex information and prepare concise briefings, presentations and decision-making materials
  • Excellent command of English and German, both written and spoken
  • Strong communication and intercultural skills and the ability to interact effectively with academic staff, university management and international partners
  • Structured, proactive and reliable working style with a high level of independence
  • Willingness to travel occasionally
  • Good command of Office 365, including MS Teams, PowerPoint, Excel and Word


Why us?

  • Opportunity to work with a great team in a dynamic and international environment
  • 30 days of vacation /5 working days per week
  •  After successfully passing the probationary period, we offer subsidies for employees’ well-being through our health budget with preventive and aftercare services
  • Various online language courses and opportunities to participate in online collaboration courses

Interested?

Then we look forward to hearing from you. Please send your application to: Jobs at University of Europe for Applied Sciences. Your application should include the following documents: CV, Cover Letter and References and possible start date.

data.title: Senior Controller / FP&A Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen - willkommen in unseren Paradiesen

Wir bei Therme Horizon schaffen besondere Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste – und entwickeln gleichzeitig unsere Unternehmensgruppe kontinuierlich weiter. Dafür bauen wir aktuell gemeinsam mit einem internationalen Finanzinvestor eine zentrale Holdingorganisation und moderne Finance-Strukturen auf.

Als Teil unseres neu aufgebauten Group-FP&A-Teams übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der gruppenweiten finanziellen Steuerung. Du verbindest klassische FP&A-Aufgaben mit Business Performance Management, strategischer Analyse und dem Aufbau moderner Finance-Prozesse.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Holding, unseren lokalen Finance-Teams und dem operativen Management unserer Standorte zusammen. Deine Themen begleitest du von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.


Der Job auf einen Blick

  • Planning & Forecasting: Verantwortung für Budget, Rolling Forecast und Mittelfristplanung – von der Prozessgestaltung und Abstimmung mit den Standorten bis zu Konsolidierung und Analyse
  • Performance Management: Steuerung des gruppenweiten Monatsabschluss- und Performance-Review-Prozesses sowie Analyse von Geschäftsentwicklung, Abweichungen und wesentlichen Performance-Treibern – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den lokalen Finance-Teams
  • Management Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des Reportings für CEO, CFO, Management und Gesellschafter inklusive der relevanten Investorenanforderungen
  • KPI-Framework & Werttreiberbäume: Entwicklung und Harmonisierung gruppenweiter KPIs und Werttreiberbäume, die die operativen Treiber des Geschäfts mit der finanziellen Performance verbinden
  • Business Cases & Ad-hoc-Analysen: Business Cases, Szenarioanalysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Management und Gesellschafter sowie eigenständige Bearbeitung strategischer Fragestellungen
  • Daten & Systeme: Weiterentwicklung unseres Data Warehouse hin zu einer gruppenweit konsolidierten Datenbasis über alle Gesellschaften, Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von LucaNet als Reporting- und Konsolidierungslösung sowie perspektiv Einführung einer Planungslösung – von den fachlichen Anforderungen über die Toolauswahl bis zum Rollout, gemeinsam mit Data & IT
  • KI & Automatisierung: Identifikation und Umsetzung von Anwendungsfällen für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI im FP&A


Skills und Werte die zu uns passen

  • Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder FP&A mit fundiertem Verständnis von Planung, Forecasting und Performance Management – alternativ ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund aus Private Equity, Transaction Advisory oder Wirtschaftsprüfung mit Wechselwunsch in die Industrie
  • Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, gepaart mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität und einem guten Gespür für das operative Geschäft
  • Freude daran, Strukturen und Prozesse von Grund auf aufzubauen, und die Eigenverantwortung, Themen bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben
  • Sie fühlen sich in einem dynamischen, sich schnell verändernden Umfeld wohl und gehen souverän mit wechselnden Prioritäten um
  • Sehr gute Excel- und Modellierungskenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte Daten- und Systemaffinität
  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzthemen für Management und operative Kolleginnen und Kollegen verständlich aufzubereiten
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen an die Standorte


Das Plus zum Traumjob


  • Exklusive Mitarbeiter-Vorteile: Nutze unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen zu besonderen Konditionen – ein echtes Plus für dein Wohlbefinden
  • Individuelle Entwicklungschancen: Wir investieren in dich und fördern dein Wachstum durch persönliche Weiterbildungen mit festem Budget
  • Stabilität & Sicherheit: Als Teil einer gewachsenen Unternehmensgruppe profitierst du von einem starken Rückhalt, modernen Strukturen und langfristiger Arbeitsplatzsicherheit
  • Mehr fürs Leben: Kita-Zuschuss, Bikeleasing, Firmenfitness und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, die über das gesetzliche Maß hinausgeht, geben dir und uns ein gutes Gefühl
  • Kostenfreie Getränke & Genuss-Vorteile: Erfrischung geht auf uns – plus attraktive Essensrabatte bei unseren Partnergastronomen


Kontakt

Diese Ausschreibung richtet sich ausdrücklich auch an Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit Behinderungen, die wir in unserem Haus stets sehr gerne beschäftigen und willkommen heißen. 

Wir machen dir das Bewerben leicht: Lade ganz einfach hier dein Motivationsschreiben in deutscher Sprache, deinen Lebenslauf und deine Zeugnisse hoch, indem du auf "Jetzt bewerben" klickst. 
Wir freuen uns darauf von dir zu lesen!

data.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
data.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

At LiveEO, we combine Space Technology with AI to solve problems here on Earth. Our satellite-based monitoring solutions help Infrastructure operators and industrial companies to make their operations more ecological, safer, and more efficient.

LiveEO is applying the latest developments in artificial intelligence to analyse satellite data and is bringing the insights of earth observation data to customers in the enterprise sector. LiveEO’s ambitious goal is to monitor 1 billion assets across the globe with its unique SaaS solution until 2030. Our team is as global as the satellite data we process and the customers we serve. Together, we are building something big.

Our Government team is growing fast: dedicated business development for Germany and for EU institutions, with more to come. What it doesn't have yet is marketing — the force multiplier. As our first dedicated Government marketing hire, you will build LiveEO's defence & government marketing from the ground up: positioning, content, PR and events, as a true generalist who owns the whole picture.


Your challenge

1. Positioning & product marketing

  • Own government/defence positioning, messaging and value propositions — resilience, situational awareness, ISR — across LiveEO's offering including our own satellite constellation, Twinspector
  • Build and maintain the collateral suite: capability briefs, decks, one-pagers, materials supporting tenders and more
  • Own the government presence on the LiveEO website and keep messaging sharp against competitor/peer positioning in the European defence-tech and EO landscape
2. Strategic communications, Content, PR & visibility
  • Build and execute the strategic communications and content plan: white papers, expert articles, use-case stories
  • Own press releases and announcements (contracts, partnerships, milestones) together with leadership
  • Build relationships with defence, security and space trade media across Germany and Europe
  • Drive executive visibility: LinkedIn presence, interviews, speaking opportunities for the Government leadership
3. Events
  • Own the defence & government event calendar across Europe (e.g. AFCEA, Berlin Security Conference, ILA, Eurosatory, space/EO industry events and NATO-affiliated formats)
  • Run participation end-to-end: selection and budget, booth/presence, speaking slots, briefing the BD team, structured lead follow-up
4. Build the function
  • Create the Government marketing playbook from scratch — processes, templates, agency/freelancer network where needed
  • Keep a simple view of what works (share of voice, inbound interest, event outcomes) and feed it back into planning with BD and central marketing


Your profile

  • 6–7+ years of marketing, sales or similar experience in the defense or security sector. You are familiar with defense-tech, military lingo and communication towards armed forces.
  • Generalist track record covering product marketing, content, PR and events — not just one discipline
  • Excellent writing and editing in German (C1+) and English — from press release to capability brief
  • Understanding of how government/defense organizations communicate and procure (protocol, sensitivity, long cycles)
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Berlin (hybrid); willingness to travel ~20–30% across Europe
  • Eligibility for security clearance (typically requiring EU or NATO citizenship)
  • Familiarity with Earth observation, space or geospatial technology is a plus
  • Additional European languages (French especially useful for EU/NATO scope) is a plus
  • Public affairs / government relations exposure is a plus


Your Benefits

  • Gain direct insights into and influence strategic business decisions shaping our go-to-market (GTM) strategy, while working on cutting-edge SaaS and AI solutions that enhance business processes and lives globally.
  • Join a rapidly growing multinational leader in an evolving and impactful industry, surrounded by a talented, international team of experts from 30+ nationalities.

data.description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

  • Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment.

  • Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount.

  • Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait to be told what to do.

  • "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams.

  • Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client.

 

Process

We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve

  3. Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study

  4. Reference call
