data.title: Sustainability advisor
data.description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for an experienced sustainability professional to join our growing Sustainability Advisor team and accelerate the adoption of best-in-class corporate sustainability programs. This is an opportunity to work directly with some of the world's largest and most influential companies as a trusted advisor on sustainability reporting and action, while partnering internally across product and go-to-market teams to serve as a thought leader and embed best-in-class sustainability intelligence into our products. You'll be on the front lines of the climate fight - crafting the sustainability strategies that make business sense and set the stage for bold action.

This role will be based out of our London office.

You will:

  • Advise sustainability leaders at many of the world's leading companies on advancing their sustainability programs. You'll independently lead strategic engagements across target-setting, decarbonization, and voluntary and regulatory reporting, partnering closely with customers to craft the business case for sustainability across every step of the journey.

  • Build sustainability intelligence by staying ahead of emerging frameworks, regulations, and market developments. You'll translate the latest sustainability trends and regulatory changes into actionable guidance for internal teams and customers, ensuring they stay compliant and competitive.

  • Help Watershed develop new products and services by exploring sustainability needs in emerging topics and industries and prototyping how we bring value to customers. You'll expand Watershed's impact by identifying opportunities and building solutions at the intersection of sustainability, advisory, and technology.



You might be a fit if you:

  • Are an L4 or higher in good standing on your current team.

  • Have 2 or more years in an advisory role and 4 or more years of professional sustainability experience. Across both roles, it is important that you have demonstrated excellence.

  • Have expertise in corporate decarbonization, are familiar with key climate frameworks such as GHGP, PCAF, SBTi, ISO, and key reporting frameworks such as CSRD, CCDAA, ASRS, ISSB, CDP, etc.

  • Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are systematic, detail-oriented, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

  • Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can present complex analyses and recommendations to C-suite audiences and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excel at driving strategic initiatives in complex organizations. You can influence decision-making while managing multiple internal and external stakeholders across different organizational levels.

  • Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to define the future of corporate sustainability at a high-growth startup.



Considered nice to have if you have:

  • Have direct experience working with financial institutions or companies in the food and agriculture sector(s)

  • Have an advanced degree in sustainability, climate science, environmental engineering, or related technical fields.

  • Are fluent in multiple languages (English, Spanish, French, or German).

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

data.title: Senior Business Travel Consultant - Flexible Shift
data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Location: Fully remote, with occasional in-person days at Birmingham Hub

Hours: A split shift built around the school day — 9:00am–2:30pm and 5:30pm–8:30pm, with the afternoon free for pickups, appointments, or whatever else needs doing. If you've been ruling out full-time roles because nothing fits around your kids' schedule, this one's designed to.

We're looking for an experienced Business Travel Consultant to join our Birmingham-hub team on a shift pattern that actually works around family life. Same great role, work, just split across the day so you're free for maybe the school run without giving up full-time hours or pay.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle travel bookings, amendments, and cancellations for business travellers with a focus on quality service

  • Arrange European and domestic travel including flights, car rentals, and hotels

  • Manage client communications via live chat, phone, and email

  • Work autonomously on client enquiries and maintain GDS queues

  • Mentor junior team members and quality-check their work

  • Develop client relationships throughout the travel lifecycle

Required Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of Galileo or Amadeus GDS systems, including ticket reissuing

  • Proficiency in air fares and ticketing

  • Previous business travel consultant experience

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to work under pressure

  • Professional telephone manner and client-facing confidence

  • Comfortable managing a split-shift routine and picking work back up mid-evening

Desirable Qualities

  • Proactive problem-solving approach

  • Flexibility and willingness to support team needs across both shift blocks

  • Positive attitude toward colleagues, suppliers, and customers

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Working Hours & Conditions

  • Working hours are flexible to accommodate school picks up during the day.

  • Role will be fully remote however you will be required to come into the Birmingham Hub for training and special events.


Interview Process

GDS Test - Online
Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Team lead + Team manager interview - 90 Min virtual
Final interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The opportunity

Checkout.com helps businesses thrive in the digital economy by making payments work better. Our Payment Performance pillar is building the intelligence that helps merchants get more value from every payment.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to take Intelligent Acceptance to its next order of magnitude—increasing the scale, breadth and merchant value of the optimizations we make. Your immediate goal will be to improve merchant profit by increasing acceptance and reducing payment costs, using fraud risk to decide when a payment should—or should not—be optimized. Longer term, you will help merchants set their own objectives and constraints, with our products intelligently choosing the best action across the payment lifecycle.

You will shape a suite of AI- and ML-powered products that make smarter optimization decisions across the payment lifecycle—from acceptance and routing to recovery and cost. The suite will continue to evolve, and part of your role will be deciding which products and capabilities should become part of it.

This is a portfolio leadership role. You will lead several Product Managers, work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics and Design, and spend time with some of the world’s most sophisticated merchants to understand their goals, prove value and shape what we build next. We are looking for a systems thinker who can turn competing objectives and fragmented capabilities into a clear strategy that teams can act on.

What you’ll do

Set the direction

  • Create and communicate a multi-year vision for merchant payment optimization.

  • Bring the portfolio together around a shared strategy, roadmap and set of product principles.

  • Decide how we balance acceptance, payment cost and fraud risk at payment and merchant level.

  • Identify the next optimization opportunities based on merchant needs, measurable value and strategic fit.

Prove and grow the value

  • Define how we measure incremental merchant value across the portfolio.

  • Build experimentation and causal measurement into how we develop, launch and improve products.

  • Own the portfolio’s product economics, including investment cases, adoption strategy and input into packaging and pricing.

  • Partner with Commercial, Finance, Product Marketing and Customer Success to make the value clear to merchants and bring new capabilities to market.

Shape Product and Data Science together

  • Co-own the Data Science roadmap and outcome metrics with the Data Science leader.

  • Ensure Product chooses the right problems and trade-offs while Data Science owns methods, model quality and scientific rigor.

  • Direct investment toward data and model capabilities that create measurable merchant impact.

  • Set a high bar for explainability, monitoring and safe rollout in high-volume payment environments.

Lead the team and portfolio

THE ROLE

The Transaction Monitoring (TM) Compliance Manager is a specialized financial crime risk and regulatory oversight role within the Second Line of Defence (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance department. The successful candidate is responsible for providing independent oversight, objective evaluation, and compliance challenges regarding the efficacy of the firm's Transaction Monitoring framework.

Acting as a Second Line Subject Matter Expert (SME), the individual defines the regulatory envelope, assesses TM risk coverage, and reviews the governance, methodologies, and documentation underpinning detection mechanisms. This role does not own control execution or technical solution design; instead, it provides independent assurance to ensure that the firm’s monitoring practices remain aligned with defined risk appetite, internal policies, and global regulatory expectations (AML/CTF/CPF).


Key Responsibilities:


1. Compliance Oversight in Risk Assessment & Horizon Scanning

  • Independent Review: Lead the ongoing 2LoD evaluation and challenge of the Compliance Risk Assessments (including EWRA and Product Risk Assessments) to ensure they accurately reflect current transaction data, typologies, and product utilization trends.

  • Regulatory Surveying & Horizon Scanning: Proactively monitor, survey, and analyze shifts in the global regulatory landscape, financial crime trends, and regulatory enforcement actions to ensure the firm's TM Compliance risk assessment framework remains comprehensive and defensible.

  • Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management.

2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework

  • Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles.

  • Compliance Oversight in Tuning & Optimization: Review and evaluate the methodologies, statistical testing parameters, and documentation for periodic "Below-the-Line" (BTL) and "Above-the-Line" (ATL) testing performed by the First Line to ensure robust governance.

  • Residual Risk Opining: Formulate independent compliance opinions regarding residual risk acceptance, providing formal advisory input to governance forums and the Global MLROs.

3. Governance, Risk, & Reporting

  • Model Risk Governance: Participate in the compliance review of TM systems and model validation exercises, independently assessing the transparency, logic, and regulatory defensibility of detection models against applicable guidance (e.g., FCA guidance on model risk management).

  • Strategic Alignment: Provide regulatory compliance support to the Head of TM to assist in aligning roadmap initiatives with the compliance maturity framework.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with cross-functional stakeholders across lines of defense to communicate compliance requirements and support the adherence to established TM standards.

  • Governance & Escalation Paths: Support the enhancement of the TM compliance governance framework to facilitate the structured, independent escalation of risk metrics to senior management.

  • Metrics & KRI Oversight: Assist in the production of 2LoD Management Information (MI) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to track the effectiveness of the compliance oversight posture for the Head of TM and Global MLRO.

3. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance

  • Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Lifecycle Evaluation: Evaluate the end-to-end alert workflow governance, risk scoring frameworks, and prioritization mechanics to ensure high-risk alerts adhere to compliant escalation paths.

  • Feedback Loops: Analyze high-level alert outcomes and disposition trends to provide compliance feedback loops to technical teams, supporting iterative improvements in the quality of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Typically 5+ years of experience within Financial Crime Compliance, with a specific focus on the independent oversight, assurance, or evaluation of Transaction Monitoring frameworks within a regulated PSP, FinTech, or financial institution.

  • 2LoD Competency: Proven experience operating within a Second Line of Defence capacity, demonstrating the ability to independently challenge technical teams, data models, and threshold tuning documentation objectively.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the UK Money Laundering Regulations (MLRs), JMLSG Guidance, and international FATF standards.

  • Systems & Data Literacy: Familiarity with data analysis methodologies, data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), or basic query languages (e.g., SQL) sufficient to independently evaluate data testing outputs, methodologies, and audit trails.

  • Education & Professional Certifications: A Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Criminology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional certifications from recognized bodies (e.g., ICA International Diploma in AML, ACAMS) are highly regarded.

data.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the team

Checkout.com is building the infrastructure that will allow merchants to be discovered, transacted with and paid through AI agents.

Agentic commerce is moving quickly from concept to production. AI platforms, card schemes and merchants are developing different protocols for discovery, cart, payment, identity and consent. No standard has won, and merchants should not have to rebuild their commerce stack for every new platform.

We are looking for a Product Manager to help make Checkout.com the layer that connects this ecosystem. This is a 0→1 role in a new product area with live merchant and platform activity, a growing inventory API, ACP and UCP work, and a roadmap that will extend across discovery, cart and payment.

What you will own

  • Define and execute the product strategy for Agentic Commerce, balancing what merchants need now with the infrastructure that will matter as the market develops.

  • Turn a fragmented protocol landscape-including ACP, UCP, Visa and Mastercard agent programmes, and emerging trust and intent standards-into a coherent, protocol-agnostic product experience.

  • Build the next stage of the product: live catalogue and inventory feeds that make merchants discoverable across AI surfaces, followed by the right cart and orchestration capabilities.

  • Extend Checkout.com’s payment strengths into agentic flows: delegated credentials, authentication, agent identification, consent, risk decisioning, approval performance and dispute evidence.

  • Work directly with AI platforms, schemes, merchants and internal commercial teams to understand real integration requirements and turn pilots into repeatable products.

  • Own the product details end to end: APIs, developer experience, merchant onboarding, operational controls, reporting, commercial model and launch readiness.

  • Lead cross-functional delivery with Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Marketing and Sales. Make decisions, resolve dependencies and keep work moving.

  • Explain complex technical and regulatory questions clearly to engineers, merchants, partners and senior leadership.

What success looks like

  • Merchants can integrate once and reach multiple AI surfaces as their protocols mature.

  • The first agentic merchants go live quickly, with a clear path from pilot to repeatable onboarding.

  • The inventory and payment experiences are reliable, observable and simple for developers to use.

  • Agentic transactions have the controls and signals needed to protect merchants, improve approval rates and handle disputes.

  • Checkout.com has a differentiated position based on merchant value and payment performance-not just a list of protocol integrations.

  • The roadmap is grounded in evidence: merchant demand, usage, approval value, integration effort and commercial potential.

Skills and experience

  • Strong product management experience building merchant-facing infrastructure, platform or API products. Experience in payments is highly valued.

  • Working knowledge of card payments: authorisation, tokenisation, PSP/acquirer flows, wallets, 3DS/SCA, risk and schemes.

  • Curiosity about AI agents and how they use tools, permissions, mandates and payment credentials. You do not need to be an AI researcher, but you do need to understand the implications for commerce and payments.

  • Evidence of owning an ambiguous 0→1 problem and taking it from customer discovery through launch and iteration.

  • The judgement to separate table stakes from genuine differentiation, and to change direction when the market or evidence changes.

  • Comfort working with external partners and senior stakeholders. You will need to represent Checkout.com, not simply attend the meeting.

This role is a good fit if

  • You are comfortable being early, technical and commercially accountable at the same time.

  • You can move between a merchant conversation, an API contract, a scheme requirement and an investment case and make each one clearer.

  • It is not a role for someone looking for a settled market, a fully formed roadmap or a narrow feature area. The opportunity is to help define the category while building something merchants can use now.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

  • Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

  • Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

  • Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

  • Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

  • Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

  • Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.

  • Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.

  • Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

 

The opportunity

  • Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers

  • Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention

  • Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics

  • Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow

  • Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

  • Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID

  • Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

Nice to haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related technical field

  • Passion for continuous learning and approaching problems with a beginner's mindset

  • Be the voice in the room. Represent marketing inside your regional sales, customer and partner teams. Bring what you hear in the market back to the business, and be the face of our brand at events, in the press and online.

  • Work smarter with AI. Use AI for research, analysis, testing, content and automation, so you move faster and your work gets better.

  • Enable the regional marketing team. Turn your best campaigns into playbooks others run, and coach fellow regional marketers.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, including at least 3 years in regional or field marketing roles with ownership of pipeline targets, not just activity.

data.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Every Alan member, from a 3-person startup to a public administration body with 200K+ collaborators is covered by an offer that our area designed, priced, contracted and renews every year.

We own the whole offer lifecycle for several kind of services (health insurance, life & disability insurance, employee benefits) across 4 countries. We manage an incredible business complexity and diversity in a scalable way, and most importantly, we empower others to act autonomously on it:

  • Offer creation: Enabling Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes, with a real-time pricer and AI assistance, without waiting days for an actuary.

  • Contract Lifecycle: Not only signing a contract in one go and writing the settings that become the source of truth for the rest of Alan, but also providing Business Ops with the tools they need to pilot over the years a portfolio of 100K+ contracts

  • Enabling growth: We’re at the root of Alan’s Insurance stack. Our technical decisions have a long reach: Claims, Billing and many other teams depends on us. We are key to lift blockers and enable the opening of new segments or markets.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

  • 🌍 One insurance stack for every country. We're replacing country-by-country code with a shared "Core Stack": one set of shared rules, with room for local differences. Spain already runs on it, and we’re now tackling France. The architecture decisions you make will shape how Alan sells insurance for the next 10 years. (How we made our offer builder global)

  • 🤖 AI-native underwriting. Insurance is complex, and most insurers need actuaries on every quote. We empower our Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes. AI-assisted smart alternatives, price explanations, pitching and more are already in the Sales hands, and there’s much more to build.

  • 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.

  • 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

  • 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards and shaping the organization and incident response as we scale to more countries. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Your users sit next to you: Hundred of Alaners use what your team ships every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.

  • Complex domain, simple software: Regulated domain, many countries, many segments… The job is to model a messy real world into a stack that stays simple and easy to extend.

  • Direct business impact. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

data.title: Senior GL Accountant
data.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

Reporting to the RTR Director based in Paris, you will be responsible for a range of General Accounting activities for Contentsquare SAS, the Group's largest entity and headquarters, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and completeness of the financial statements in accordance with IFRS and French GAAP.

This is a fixed-term contract starting in mid-January 2027, to cover a parental leave.

What you’ll do

  • Support day-to-day General Ledger operations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and accounting adjustments.
  • Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities in accordance with IFRS and French GAAP.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual tax declarations and support statutory audits.
  • Maintain accurate records of prepaid expenses, accruals, provisions, and fixed assets.
  • Contribute to the preparation of internal and external financial reporting.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams including FP&A, Legal, HR, Procurement, and other business stakeholders.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and ERP system enhancements.
  • Support the implementation, maintenance, and documentation of accounting policies and internal controls.
  • Ensure compliance with internal accounting procedures and relevant local and international accounting standards.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Advanced degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in General Accounting, ideally gained across both an accounting firm and an in-house/corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS is required; knowledge of US GAAP is a plus.
  • Fluency in French and English, as you will work in a truly international environment.
  • Strong analytical and technical accounting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and reliable, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet strict reporting deadlines.
  • Comfortable joining a team for a fixed-term assignment and quickly becoming operational.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience in the Tech / SaaS sector.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including VBA.
  • Experience working with Workday Financials.
  • Previous experience in an international or multi-entity organization.
Why you should join Contentsquare
We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
 
Here are a few we want to highlight:
- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
- Lifestyle allowance
- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
- And more benefits tailored to each country
 
Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
 
Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
 
Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer.

  • Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search.

  • Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

  • Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers.

     

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company.

  • You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles.

  • You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer.

  • You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space.

  • A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem.

  • Proven experience on Ashby ATS.

     

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

 

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

     

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework.

  • Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

     

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

 

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

You'll join Malt's AI & Automation Team to build the AI & Automation backbone of our commercial organization. Working hand in hand with commercial leadership and reps, you'll design the workflows that keep our CRM sharp, surface the right signal at the right time, and power a highly personalized outreach machine. You'll also be the team's eyes on what's next in AI & automation, testing new ideas with beta users and pushing the ones that work into production.

Key responsibilities ✨

  • Design and build AI & Automation workflows (n8n, Dust, and more) integrating Salesforce, enrichment providers, and other data sources to keep CRM data accurate and complete.

  • Manage and maintain integrations across the commercial tool ecosystem (e.g., Aircall, Modjo, Clay) to ensure seamless data flow and eliminate manual syncs.

  • Detect buying signals (company changes, job moves, funding, market shifts) and route them into commercial workflows so reps act at the right moment.

  • Build and scale a highly personalized outreach engine, using LLMs to tailor messaging for the commercial team at scale.

  • Identify beta testers among the commercial team, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on feedback and data.

  • Track AI & automation trends through ongoing tech watch, and bring back new ideas, tools, and patterns.

  • Implement reliability patterns and document the architecture of the workflows you ship.

  • Partner closely with commercial leadership and reps to prioritize the roadmap and train users on new tools.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Engineering background: You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering (Bac+5 or equivalent), combining technical rigor with a strong business sensitivity to bridge tech and commercial teams.

  • Automations & Integrations: You have hands-on experience building workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier) and connecting commercial stack tools (Salesforce, Aircall, Modjo, Clay) via native integrations, APIs, or webhooks.

  • AI & Data stack: You are comfortable with the LLM/AI ecosystem (OpenAI API, Dust, LangChain, Mistral) and solid with SQL and scripting (Python/JavaScript) to connect systems end-to-end.

  • Commercial empathy: You understand sales processes and genuinely enjoy working close to commercial teams to remove their daily friction.

  • Languages: You have professional working proficiency in English.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Alexandre, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes)

  • A 60-minute session with your future manager, Léo Martin, to explore your background and the role’s specifics. 

  • Live practical case with Léo Martin and another Malter in order to evaluate and discuss technical topics, problem-solving approaches, and ways of working.

  • Final interview with Anaïs to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and how you fit into our strategic growth.

    • Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Team building events organized every year
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.

data.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams.

The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan's effectiveness against Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Integrated Marketing Planning & Business Performance — France

  • Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market.

  • Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar.

  • Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan.

  • Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies.

  • Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans.

  • Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative.

2. Orchestrating 360° Campaigns

  • Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines.

  • Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market.

  • Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams.

  • Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision.

3. Tracking, Performance & Governance

  • Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins.

  • Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs.

  • Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected.

  • Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners.

  • Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans.

4. Agencies & Partnerships

  • Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval.

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning.

  • Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners.

Ways of Working

  • Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence.

  • Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities.

  • Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders.

Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation.

 

Key Skills

  • Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives.

  • Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations.

  • Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution.

  • Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency.

  • Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations.

  • Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies.

  • Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market.

Success Measures

  • One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams.

  • Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity.

  • Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans.

  • Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated.

  • Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

  • Clear stakeholder visibility on priorities, risks, decisions and results.

Why This Role?

This role offers unique exposure to Deliveroo France's strategic marketing challenges, working directly with local leadership and central functional teams. It provides a strong platform for progression into broader Integrated Marketing responsibilities.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

data.title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design.

Key responsibilities

In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design.

  • Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads.

  • Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.

  • Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases.

  • Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability.

  • Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis.

  • Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification.

  • Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design.

During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase:

  • Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise.

  • Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour.

  • Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results.

  • Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes.

What we would love to see from you

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees.

  • Over 1 year of related experience in CAD design and stress analysis of mechanical or structural hardware, ideally in a propulsion, aerospace or high-reliability environment.

  • Strong CAD skills, able to take a part from concept to a fully detailed, manufacturable design.

  • Solid grounding in structural/stress analysis, including hand calculations and FEA (e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, additive manufacturing, welding/brazing) and their impact on design and structural performance.

  • Nice to have: CFD experience, for thermal or flow-related analysis of propulsion hardware.

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.
